name: uma
description: Persistent, evidence-backed memory for Kimi Code. Remembers decisions, patterns, and preferences across sessions via the local uma-mcp server.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-backed memory layer for AI coding workflows
interface.longDescription: UMA adds persistent, evidence-backed memory to Kimi Code via a local uma-mcp server. Curated context and compiled memory are retrieved with provenance, and each session's last exchange is captured automatically so Kimi keeps continuity across restarts.
